title: Taxi fare meter
description: A pixel taxi meter: a base fare of 3.00, 1.50 per km and 0.40 per minute waiting; buttons add 1 km or 1 minute, show distance, waiting time and the fare to two decimals, and a New trip button.

title: Bowling scorer
description: A pixel bowling score sheet for one player: buttons 0 to 10 enter pins per roll, the sheet shows 10 frames with strikes and spares marked, the running total per frame and the final score.

title: Flood fill
description: A pixel flood-fill toy on a 6x6 grid with a fixed starting pattern of 3 colors: pick a color and click a cell to fill its connected same-color area, count moves, and show 'One color!' when the grid is uniform.

title: Recipe unit converter
description: A pixel kitchen converter: an amount and a unit (cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, millilitres), convert to every other unit with 1 cup = 16 tbsp = 48 tsp = 240 ml, shown to one decimal.

title: Departure board
description: A pixel train departure board with 6 built-in trains (destination, time, platform), a clock you can advance by 5 minutes, trains that have left are greyed out, and the next departure is highlighted.

title: Snakes and ladders
description: A pixel snakes-and-ladders board of 30 squares with 3 fixed ladders and 3 fixed snakes for one player: a Roll button moves by a die roll, ladders and snakes move the token, show the square and a win message at 30.

title: Itemised bill split
description: A pixel bill splitter: add items with a price and tick which of 3 people shared each item, show what each person owes including a tip percent applied to their share, rounded to cents.

title: Caesar cipher
description: A pixel Caesar cipher tool: a text box, a shift from 1 to 25, Encode and Decode buttons, letters keep their case, other characters stay unchanged, and the result is shown in a box.
